raw_response:
This small plot of cassava and cocoyam is just behind my house, so I can manage it myself with help from my children. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer for such a tiny piece of land, but I will spread the kitchen ash and goat droppings I gather at home. I will use the cassava cuttings I saved from last season like my mother taught me, and the rain here in the South South is plenty so I do not need to water.
